thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 tail latency spike detected for /v1/stream (region: eu-west-1) :rotating_light:

sre-jordan: saw the alert, looking at metrics now. p95 ~ 420ms normal, p99 jumped to ~3.4s on streaming endpoints.

oncall-maya: I'm paged, taking lead. any customer reports? @cs-ana?

cs-ana: 2 customers flagged streaming timeouts, both on dedicated capacity. I'm opening two tickets and linking.

infra-lee: NVidia GPU node stack shows GPU node gpu-node-12 high response times, spool of retries. starting live-checks.

eng-runtime: quick question — did we roll any kernel/driver in eu-west last hour? deploy-bot: deploys: none in last 2h.

deploy-bot: No deployments in the last 2 hours for runtime-service.

oncall-maya: ok infra, please collect nvidia logs & ECC counters. if ECC or thermal, we'll drain.

infra-lee: running nvml query, output snippet:

```
# nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ECC,UTILIZATION -i 12
GiB Memory Utilization : 95 %
Ecc Errors (Volatile) : Corrected 128, Uncorrected 3
Power Draw : 250W
Temperature : 92 C

-- dmesg snippet --
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
```

sre-jordan: Uncorrected ECC 3 is concerning, temp 92C. That matches hardware throttling and retry storms — explains streaming stalls.

oncall-maya: Initiating mitigation: 1) enable immediate live drain of gpu-node-12 2) route traffic away from dedicated pool in eu-west until nodes stable 3) enable fallback model variant (quantized-small) for streaming where possible.

eng-runtime: adding a temporary routing rule:
```
route:
  match: "/v1/stream"
  policy: prefer eu-west-dedicated:fallback -> eu-west-shared
```

oncall-maya: infra, please cordon+drain gpu-node-12 now. keep one connection to fetch logs but no new allocations.

infra-lee: cordoned gpu-node-12, starting drain. evicting pods, triggering fallback to shared cluster. ETA 45s.

sre-jordan: p99 dropped from 3.4s to 680ms within 90s of routing change. p95 back to ~480ms. Streaming stall count down by 70%.

cs-ana: letting affected customers know PSAT; offering regened credits if sessions dropped. sending templated note.

pm-sam: timeline ok — can we capture exact time of p99 crossing and restore for postmortem? also need impact delta per customer.

sre-jordan: metrics snapshot attached (short):

- 2432109876 alert p99 3.4s
- 2432109950 routing change applied
- 2432109990 p99 0.68s
- 2432110100 p99 0.45s

oncall-maya: infra, please collect full nvml logs, dmesg, and hardware SN. file a ticket with HW team to replace GPU if ECC persists.

infra-lee: captured logs, uploaded to /infra/incidents/2432109876/logs, GPU SN: GPU-AB12C34, will open RMA.

eng-runtime: quick hotfix idea: add a short-circuit for repeated ECC-related retries in runtime to failfast after 5 attempts — reduces stall amplification. I'll open a PR and ship to staging.

sre-jordan: agree, that would reduce cascading stalls. assign eng-runtime action item.

oncall-maya: customer impact: 4 sessions timed out across 2 customers, total 27 requests failed. Notified CS and sales.

cs-ana: confirmed recipients. No active SLA breach yet for most, but a couple of p99 SLO windows triggered. logged accordingly.

pm-sam: schedule a follow-up postmortem timeline: incident review tomorrow 11:00 UTC. prepare timeline + root-cause hypotheses.

oncall-maya: summary actions:
- drained gpu-node-12 (done)
- routed traffic to shared pool (done)
- collected logs & started RMA (infra)
- PR for failfast retries (eng-runtime)
- customer comms (cs)

infra-lee: RMA ticket #RMA-78933 created, vendor dispatched.

eng-runtime: PR opened: runtime#1548 "failfast-ecc-retries" — will add feature flag for quick rollout. cc @oncall-maya

sre-jordan: marking incident as mitigated at 2432110100. keeping thread open for postmortem artifacts.

oncall-maya: assigning postmortem owner: @sre-jordan. please include metric graphs, nvml dumps, routing rule diff, and customer impact table.

cs-ana: will attach customer ticket IDs to the postmortem doc.

pm-sam: blameless review — focus on detection and mitigation improvements: better ECC threshold alerts and automated drain policy for >2 uncorrected ECC in 10m.

oncall-maya: closing handoff. If anything else pops up, re-open. :white_check_mark:
